prompt: Build for this brief: A public information service; people find reliable guidance quickly. Use Spectrum 1-7: page #FBF9FA, text #2D1F20, accent #865C1D, secondary surface #E7EFE7, text on accent #FFFFFF. Set headings in Junicode and reading text in Aileron; humanist reading serif with economical sans text. Composition: Three-column product grid, consistent image ratios, filter rail, one-column mobile. Use body 16px, heading 80px, line height 1.75, reading measure at most 40ch, gap 24px, content width at most 960px and item radius 0px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
